--- a/agents/core/archive_safe.py

@@ -715,6 +715,9 @@
                     raise ArchiveRejected(f"truncated member: {_show(member.name)}")
                 result[name] = {"sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "size": member.size,
                                 "mode": member.mode, "data": bytes(data) if data is not None else None}
+                # Inspection uses direct TarInfo handles and refuses links. Retaining
+                # past headers only multiplies inherited global PAX dictionaries.
+                tar.members.clear()
             _drain_padding(tar.fileobj)
     except _CORRUPT as exc:
         raise ArchiveRejected(f"archive is corrupt or truncated: {exc}") from exc
